name: City Council - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 22, 2015 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Tree City USA 4th Year Dedication Presentation by Lynnette Short from California State Forester (Cal Fire).
4B.
Proclamation for Arbor Day in the City of Encinitas.
4C.
Proclamation regarding Mothers Against Drunk Driving (MADD) PowerTalk 21 Day.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 4/8/15 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2015-04-22 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Award of a California Coastal Conservancy Grant for a Cardiff State Beach Living Shoreline Conceptual Plan. Contact Person: Program Administrator Weldon
1) Accept grant funds from the California Coastal Conservancy in the amount of $150,000 for the development of a Cardiff State Beach Living Shoreline Conceptual Plan; 2) Adopt Resolution 2015-11 designating the City Manager or his designee as an authorized representative for the City of Encinitas to execute agreements with the California Coastal Conservancy; and 3) Authorize the City Manager to execute a professional services agreement, not to exceed $150,000, for the development of the Cardiff State Beach Living Shoreline Conceptual Plan.
2015-04-22 Item 8B - Cardiff State Beach Living Shoreline Conceptual Plan
8C.
A Resolution of the City of Encinitas City Council consenting to the termination of SANDPIPA and approving amendments to the SANDPIPA Joint Powers Agreement Articles 25A and 25B. Contact Person: Risk Department Manager Schwarm
Approve Resolution 2015-22 providing written consent to the termination of San Diego Pooled Insurance Program Authority, (SANDPIPA) per Article 25 of the Joint Powers Agreement to be effective July 1, 2016 and approve amendments to the Joint Powers Agreement, Articles 25A and 25B. Direct staff to communicate this Resolution to SANDPIPA.
2015-04-22 Item 8C - SANDPIPA Termination
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Continued public hearing for consideration and approval of Resolution 2015-13 approving the FY2015-16 CDBG program budget, FY2015-20 Consolidated Plan and FY2015-16 Action Plan, and authorization for the City Manager to transmit the FY2015-20 Consolidated Plan and FY2015-16 Annual Action Plan with required certifications to the Department of Housing and Urban Development. Contact Person: Management Analyst Piano-Jones
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2015-13 approving the proposed FY2015-16 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) budget, FY2015-20 Consolidated Plan and FY2015-16 Action Plan; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to transmit the FY2015-20 Consolidated Plan and FY2015-16 Action Plan and required certifications to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD).
2015-04-22 Item 10A - FY2015-20 Consolidated Plan and FY2015-16 Action Plan
10B.
Public Hearing and introduction of Ordinance 2015-03 Setting Cardiff Sanitary Division Sewer Service Rates and Ordinance 2015-04 Setting Encinitas Sanitary Division Sewer Service Rates. Contact Person: Management Analyst Wilson
Conduct public hearing and introduce Ordinance 2015-03 Setting Cardiff Sanitary Division Sewer Service Rates and Ordinance 2015-04 Setting Encinitas Sanitary Division Sewer Service Rates.
2015-04-22 Item 10B - Sanitary Division Sewer Service Rates Public Hearing
10C.
Public Hearing and introduction of Ordinance 2015-07, an Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 20.08 - Stormwater Management & Discharge Control Ordinance. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
1) Receive the report; 2) Conduct the public hearing; and 3) Introduce Ordinance No. 2015-07, titled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 20.08 - Stormwater Management & Discharge Control Ordinance."
2015-04-22 Item 10C - Stormwater Ordinance Amendments 2015-07
10D.
Overview of the City's current inclusionary housing regulations, summary of court cases that impact inclusionary housing regulations and possible options for Council consideration in updating the City's codes. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
1) Consider information in the agenda report and provide direction on the identified options for updating the City's Inclusionary Housing Ordinance. Staff recommends that all of the options listed be included in the ordinance update; 2) Direct staff to prepare a Housing Nexus Study to determine the appropriate requirement and/or fee for the inclusionary housing regulations; and 3) Should Council opt to prepare a Housing Nexus Study, allocate an additional $20,000 for the project, and direct staff to request the additional allocation as part of the FY15/17 Two-year Operational Budget.
2015-04-22 Item 10D - Inclusionary Housing Regulations
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2015-04-22 Item 15 - City Manager' s Follow Up Log
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
